task_summary: Closed the password-reset proof bypass by requiring the caller-supplied verified OTP, atomically consuming it once, and forwarding it from the reset form.
key_decisions: Require a verified reset OTP and possession of its exact code at password update.
Atomically delete the matching unexpired OTP before password persistence.
lessons_learned: Email-level OTP verification flags do not prove the current reset caller possesses the code.
Conditional atomic delete enforces one-time proof under concurrent requests.
